bio:
Anna P. Heffernan (29 Jul 1876 - 12 Oct 1960) married at Pueblo, Colorado, on 26 Nov 1901 Felix John Murphy (1874-1955), a banker at First National; one daughter, Florence (b. 1902).

In 1900 "Annie," 23, was a tailoress in her parents' Plymouth home ([R4-S9]). FamilySearch names her daughter Mary Florence Murphy (1902-1951), who married James F. Poland; that Luzerne marriage record names her mother as Anna Heffernan ([R4-S1]). FS gives Felix Murphy's birth as 1876 and death 22 Apr 1955; his parents were John Felix Murphy (1851-1890) and Mary Kelly ([R4-S2]).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
